description: Structured eval definitions for the OpenSearch Index Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across OpenSearch index scenarios (production logs with ILM tiering, k-NN vector search with HNSW, zero-downtime alias reindex, data stream for time-series metrics, missing domain endpoint prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production logs index with ILM hot/warm/cold tiering
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — production logs index with strict mapping, 5 primary shards for 150 GB, ILM rollover at 50 GB/1d, warm at 7d, delete at 90d, rollover alias
eval_cases.prompt: Create an OpenSearch index for application logs on domain search-mydomain-abc123.us-east-1.es.amazonaws.com. Estimated 150 GB of logs per day. Use strict dynamic mapping. 5 primary shards, 1 replica. Create an ILM policy that rolls over at 50 GB or 1 day, moves to warm after 7 days, and deletes after 90 days. Rollover alias logs-app-write. Index template logs-template for pattern logs-app-*. Tags: Environment=production, Application=app-logs.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_INDEX: logs-app-000001
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Dynamic mapping: strict
  [✓] Primary shards: 5 (target: ~30 GB/shard)
  [✓] Replica shards: 1
  [✓] ILM policy: logs-ilm-policy (rollover: 50gb | 1d)
  [✓] Rollover alias: logs-app-write (is_write_index: true)
  [✓] Index template: logs-template
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  curl -s "<endpoint>/logs-app-000001" -u "user:pass"

eval_cases.name: k-NN vector search index with HNSW and cosine similarity
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — k-NN vector search index with 768 dimensions, HNSW method, cosinesimil space type, nmslib engine, ef_construction 512, m 48
eval_cases.prompt: Create a k-NN vector search index on domain search-vectordomain-xyz789.us-east-1.es.amazonaws.com. 768-dimensional embeddings from a sentence transformer model. Use HNSW method with cosine similarity and nmslib engine. ef_construction 512, m 48. 3 primary shards, 1 replica. Index name vector-search-v1. Tags: Environment=production, UseCase=semantic-search.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_INDEX: vector-search-v1
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] k-NN vector search: enabled (dimension: 768, method: hnsw, space: cosinesimil)
  [✓] Primary shards: 3
  [✓] Replica shards: 1

eval_cases.name: Zero-downtime alias reindex with mapping change
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — zero-downtime reindex from products-v1 to products-v2, add SKU keyword field, change metadata from object to nested, alias swap
eval_cases.prompt: Create a zero-downtime reindex plan on domain search-prod-abc.us-east-1.es.amazonaws.com. Current index products-v1 needs a mapping change: add a new SKU keyword field and change metadata from object to nested. Create products-v2 with updated mappings. Use alias products for read traffic. 5 primary shards, 1 replica. Strict dynamic mapping. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_INDEX: products-v2
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Alias: products → products-v2
  [✓] Reindex: products-v1 → products-v2
  [✓] Mapping change: metadata nested, SKU keyword added

eval_cases.name: Data stream for time-series metrics with ILM integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — data stream for metrics-ds, 10 primary shards for 200 GB/day, data stream template with ILM rollover and tiering
eval_cases.prompt: Create a data stream for application metrics on domain search-metrics-abc.us-east-1.es.amazonaws.com. Metrics include timestamp, metric_name, value, and tags. Expected 200 GB per day. 10 primary shards, 1 replica. Data stream name metrics-ds. Create a data stream template with ILM integration for rollover and tiering. Tags: Environment=production, DataType=metrics.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_INDEX: metrics-ds (data stream)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data stream: enabled
  [✓] Primary shards: 10
  [✓] Rollover: automatic (data stream lifecycle)

eval_cases.name: OpenSearch index request without domain endpoint (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — operator does not provide domain endpoint or auth credentials
eval_cases.prompt: Create an OpenSearch index for my application. 5 primary shards, 1 replica. I need ILM and alias management.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_INDEX: unknown
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Domain endpoint: not provided — index creation requires a reachable OpenSearch domain endpoint
  [✗] Auth credentials: not provided — sigv4 or basic auth required
